svg.aria-label: Jack Nguyen. Analytics-driven product builder. What did Jack build at Lumist? He co-founded Lumist, an AI-powered SAT prep platform, and led product and analytics. It reached 11,000+ users as of Oct 18, 2026. AI Tutor daily active users went from 24 to 400+ by Aug 4, 2026.
